name: RC-B10-0106/2025 – § 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text: Calls for the EU and its Member States, as well as national parliaments and interparliamentary institutions, not to recognise the legitimacy of the Georgian Dream one-party parliament and their appointed president; calls, therefore, on the international community to join the boycott of the self-proclaimed Georgian authorities;
